2121982559030788157.en_summary: TWELVE HOURS IN THE JENSEN HUANG CASE FROM 10PM TO 10AM on 11/15/26. In this window the channel record widened again: the Wall Street Journal reported records showing Megaspeed arranged to send nearly $12 billion of top Nvidia chips to companies in China, a fifth chip figure with its own window, and reported an unwritten Nvidia rule capping partners' Chinese customers and a new channel node, Aolani Cloud. Megaspeed answered publicly for the first time on Alice Huang, saying she left the company effective August 30, 2025 and that it has retained outside counsel for an internal investigation. The Washington Post reported Huang is quietly helping pick his own successor, and Elon Musk said many of Nvidia's supply deals were a handshake with Huang personally.
2121982559030788157.zh_summary: 黃仁勳案件從11/15/26晚上10點到上午10點的十二小時。在這個窗口，渠道記錄再次擴大：華爾街日報報導記錄顯示Megaspeed安排向中國公司發送近120億美元的頂級英偉達芯片，第五個芯片數字有自己的窗口，並報導了英偉達未寫明的規則限制合作夥伴的中國客戶以及新渠道節點Aolani Cloud。Megaspeed首次公開回應Alice Huang，稱她於2025年8月30日離開公司，並已聘請外部律師進行內部調查。華盛頓郵報報導黃仁勳正在悄悄幫助挑選自己的繼任者，埃隆·馬斯克說英偉達的許多供應交易是與黃仁勳個人的握手。
